note.ja: 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

method_note.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
method_note.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

equation_note.ja: 無次元1D Bratu、31内点、u(0)=u(1)=0。既存の2係数モデルと保存済み観測を再利用。正則化γとLM減衰μを別に扱います。
equation_note.en: A dimensionless one-dimensional Bratu problem with 31 interior nodes and zero Dirichlet data. The existing two-coefficient extension and saved observations are reused; objective regularization gamma and LM damping mu are distinct.

reference_note.ja: 独立Thomas状態・感度と4局所参照fit。最終状態残差、物理勾配または投影勾配、目的値差、データのみのSVD、活性境界を検査。非有界法の共通参照は内点かつ非有界停留が条件です。
reference_note.en: Independent Thomas states/sensitivities and four local reference fits. Gate final state residuals, physical gradient or projected gradient, objective gaps, data-only SVD and active bounds. Common references for unbounded methods must be strictly interior and unbounded-stationary.

note.ja: 小さい滑らかな分枝の局所比較。SciPy最適化ライブラリは参照側でも共有し、大域最小・一意性を証明しません。LMに箱制約があるとは説明しません。
note.en: A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method.

method_note.ja: 独自SVD最小二乗GN/LM、元の投影勾配、SciPy TRF、非有界SciPy LM。lower/upperベクトルを元PGの係数別区間へ明示変換。
method_note.en: Original SVD least-squares GN/LM, the retained projected-gradient solver, SciPy TRF and explicitly unbounded SciPy LM. A canonical lower/upper box is explicitly adapted to the legacy per-parameter intervals.

equation_note.ja: 無次元の非有界代数的最適化。既知の解析最小点を持ち、物理PDEの境界条件はありません。
equation_note.en: Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization with known analytic minima; there is no physical PDE boundary condition.

reference_note.ja: 16固定fit、解析的な最小点・勾配、各受理stepのstrong Wolfeと解像された正曲率、BFGSの対称SPD、L-BFGS作用差を判定。保持組とoracle稠密行列の記憶を分離。
reference_note.en: Sixteen fixed fits check analytic minima/gradients, strong Wolfe and resolved positive curvature at every accepted step, symmetric SPD BFGS matrices and L-BFGS action defects. Retained-pair and dense-oracle storage are reported separately.

note.ja: 厳密線形探索ではないためn反復終了や一般的Rosenbrock大域収束を主張しません。原著選択箇所は弱Wolfeであり、本例のstrong Wolfeと区別。Fletcher1970本文は未読です。
note.en: No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.

method_note.ja: 独自逆BFGSとベクトルだけの2-loop L-BFGS（3組）。独立な小稠密oracleは現在γ₀Iから現在保持する組だけを古い順に再生。SciPy BFGS/L-BFGS-B（bounds=None）を別実装として比較。
method_note.en: Original inverse-BFGS and vector-only two-loop L-BFGS with three pairs. A separate small dense oracle replays only currently retained pairs from the current gamma0 I. SciPy BFGS and unbounded L-BFGS-B are distinct software companions.

equation_note.ja: Bratu推定は31内点、5観測、W=I/5、Σ=σ²I。既存1023格子のデータは保存値を使い再生成しません。σ=1e-4/1e-3、seed67001/67002、γの固定5点です。
equation_note.en: Bratu inference uses 31 interior nodes, five observations, W=I/5 and Sigma=sigma² I. Existing 1023-grid observations are reused without regeneration. Fixed sigma values are 1e-4/1e-3, seeds are 67001/67002 and the gamma list has five entries.

reference_note.ja: 42 fitの最終残差・物理KKT・実行完了、選択規則、明示的2×2代数による固定線形モデルの共分散・偏り・モデル差応答、対称PSDを検査。
reference_note.en: Gate final residuals, physical KKT conditions and completion for all 42 fits, the selection rule, and covariance/bias/model-shift response against explicit scalar 2x2 algebra, including symmetry and PSD.

note.ja: 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
note.en: Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.

method_note.ja: 全γのfitを資格した完全経路だけから、実現雑音ノルムの1.05倍を満たす最大γを選択。不完全経路と完全だが候補なしを分離。4点L-curveは記述診断。
method_note.en: Select the largest admissible gamma using 1.05 times the realized noise norm only after the full gamma path qualifies. Incomplete paths and complete paths with no admissible gamma are distinct. Four-point L-curves are descriptive diagnostics.

equation_note.ja: 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。 モデル時間0から4。中間種と残差の尺度は1e-4。公式印字値の丸め幅と数値誤差を区別します。
equation_note.en: A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs. Model time zero to four; the intermediate-species state and residual scale is 1e-4. Printing intervals and numerical errors are distinct.

reference_note.ja: 22共通時刻の実誤差、全受理時刻の質量/最小値、真の段階残差、実RHS/Jacobian/因子/solve数を別判定します。 元39目標をすべて実測し、精度・細分化4目標の未達を変更せず研究結果として記録します。他35条件と独立参照・保存配列からの判定再計算は必須です。
reference_note.en: Check actual errors at 22 common times, mass and minimum values at every accepted state, true stage residuals, and actual RHS, Jacobian, factorization and linear-solve counts separately. Evaluate all 39 original targets, retaining the four unmet accuracy/refinement goals as study outcomes. The other 35 requirements, independent references and faithful saved-array recomputation remain mandatory.

note.ja: 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。
note.en: Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.

note.ja: 公式SUNDIALS v7.1.1の2印字行のみ。IDAの新規実行0、長時間の化学精度や一般DAE性能は扱いません。 この固定時間格子の漸近収束や元精度目標の全合格は主張しません。
note.en: Only two official SUNDIALS v7.1.1 printed rows; zero new IDA executions, with no long-time chemistry or general DAE-performance claim. No asymptotic-convergence or all-original-accuracy-goals claim is made for this fixed schedule.

method_note.ja: BDF2は同格子BE開始。SDIRK2の非線形段階は重み付き最大残差で判定し、同じ段階内だけJacobian因子を再利用。適応法はRMS倍分割誤差と2半刻みを採用。 解析Jacobian付き固定BE/Newtonを使い、質量の投影・濃度クリップはしません。
method_note.en: BDF2 starts with backward Euler on the same grid. SDIRK2 stages use a weighted maximum residual and reuse Jacobian factors only within one stage. Adaptive steps use an RMS step-doubling estimate and accept the two-half-step result. Use fixed BE/Newton with analytic Jacobians and no mass projection or concentration clipping.

equation_note.ja: x′=v,v′=μ(1−x²)v−x、初期値(2,0)、T=2。2方式×3刻み×2μと適応4runで計16run。
equation_note.en: The system is xprime = v and vprime = mu(1 - x squared)v - x, initially (2, 0), over T = 2. Two fixed methods, three step counts and two mu values plus four adaptive runs give 16 runs.

reference_note.ja: 資格済みRadau/BDFと21時刻で比較。元の全判定を偽値も含め保存し、他208条件と、結果の忠実な表示・実局所制御・元失敗保存の3検証を別に要求します。
reference_note.en: Compare 21 sampled times with qualified Radau and BDF references. Preserve every original decision, including false values. Require the other 208 conditions separately from three checks of faithful disclosure, actual local controls and retained original failure evidence.

note.ja: 測定後の報告範囲変更で、数値的な修復ではありません。初回誤差4.535633779e-5は元目標2e-5を超えます。局所rtolは大域誤差を保証せず、報告検証の合格は全元目標の達成ではありません。大μ全周期は対象外です。
note.en: This post-measurement reporting revision is not a numerical repair. The first error, 4.535633779e-5, exceeded the original 2e-5 goal. Local tolerances do not guarantee global accuracy, and reporting PASS does not mean all original goals were met. Full large-mu cycles are outside scope.

method_note.ja: BDF2/SDIRK2と倍分割適応法。解析Jacobian・段階内だけの因子再利用・失敗時の候補保存を実装します。
method_note.en: Use actual BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling, analytic Jacobians, factor reuse within each implicit stage, and retained candidates on failure.

equation_note.ja: γ=.2,ω=3、初期値(1,0)、T=2。3対のrtol/atol×2最大刻みと終端交差2runで計8run。
equation_note.en: Use gamma = 0.2, omega = 3, initial state (1, 0), and T = 2. Three paired relative and absolute tolerances with two maximum steps, plus two terminal runs, give eight runs.

reference_note.ja: 解析状態とπ/6,π/2の単純交差を参照に、端点/97オフメッシュ点/イベント時刻・残差と実nfev=1+6試行数を判定。
reference_note.en: Analytic states and the simple crossings at pi/6 and pi/2 provide independent truth. Check endpoints, 97 off-mesh samples, event times and residuals, and the actual identity nfev = 1 + 6 times the attempted-step count.

note.ja: 接触根・1刻み内の多重交差・reset付き系の一般性は保証しません。初期零/所有権/resetは限定成分対照で、局所許容誤差と大域精度を同一視しません。
note.en: There is no general guarantee for tangential roots, multiple crossings within a step or systems with resets. Initial-zero and ownership controls are limited component tests; local tolerances and global accuracy remain distinct.

method_note.ja: 実Dormand–Prince5(4)・quartic連続拡張・受理状態が所有するFSAL・保存補間上の符号区間二分法。拒否端点を昇格しません。
method_note.en: Use actual Dormand–Prince 5(4) stages, a quartic continuous extension, an accepted-state derivative cache and bracket bisection on retained interpolants. A rejected endpoint never replaces the accepted starting derivative.

equation_note.ja: u_t=u_xx+u、[0,1]、両端u=1、解析定常解+.1正弦摂動、T=.1。内部31/63/127点・8/16/32/64刻みとLie対照4run、計28run。
equation_note.en: Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs.

reference_note.ja: 独立疎affine指数作用と別記述の正弦和を先に資格。同FD時間誤差・解析連続解との差・固定格子/刻み領域の観測次数を判定。
reference_note.en: First qualify an independent sparse affine exponential action against separately written sine sums. Then separate temporal error against the same finite-difference system, spatial error against the analytic continuum field, and observed order in the fixed regime.

note.ja: 原著の線形特殊例で非線形数値表の再現ではありません。非自律/一般境界や普遍的な次数低下は主張せず、Lie終端の反応trace不整合も別表示します。
note.en: This is an authored linear specialization, not a reproduction of the original nonlinear tables. It makes no general claim for nonautonomous boundaries or universal order loss. The final reaction-trace mismatch of Lie splitting is disclosed separately.

method_note.ja: w=u−1で未補正(Lw,w+1)、補正(Lw+1,w)に分割。実DirichletDST-I指数流を合成し、反応の境界不整合を保持します。
method_note.en: For w = u - 1, use the unmodified split (Lw, w + 1) or the corrected split (Lw + 1, w). Compose actual Dirichlet DST-I flows and retain the reaction boundary mismatch.

equation_note.ja: 無次元の固定16点・周期・線形残差。疑似時間は反復パラメータです。
equation_note.en: A fixed dimensionless sixteen-node periodic linear residual; pseudo-time is an iteration parameter.

reference_note.ja: 元の41数値目標と実際の真偽を変更せず保存します。増幅制御の絶対残差目標だけを研究結果として分離し、他40条件と保存配列からの判定再計算・正確な表示を必須にします。
reference_note.en: Retain all 41 original numerical targets and their actual decisions. Only the expanding-control absolute residual goal is a separate study outcome; the other 40 requirements and faithful recomputation from saved arrays remain mandatory.

note.ja: 固定線形例に限定。JST圧縮性流束や非線形4次RK、任意初期値の収束は検証しません。 元の全数値目標の合格を意味する公開ではありません。
note.en: Limited to a fixed linear example; no JST compressible flux, nonlinear fourth-order RK or all-start convergence claim. Verification of this study does not mean that all original numerical targets were met.

method_note.ja: 全段で同じ基底状態を用い、全場・全段残差・評価回数を保存します。
method_note.en: Use the same base state in every stage and retain complete fields, stage residuals and evaluation counts.

equation_note.ja: 無次元・正枝。微分行と代数行の尺度はそれぞれ1で、最大ノルムを用います。
equation_note.en: Dimensionless positive branch; differential and algebraic row scales are both one, with the maximum norm.

reference_note.ja: 独立Decimal製造解・3つの離散根と3固定格子を比較し、一次誤差と代数拘束を確認します。
reference_note.en: Compare independent Decimal manufactured states, three discrete roots and three fixed grids, checking first-order error and the algebraic constraint.

note.ja: 単一の製造正枝・固定BE計算です。IDA実行や一般DAEソルバーの検証ではありません。
note.en: One authored positive branch and fixed BE runs; no IDA execution or general DAE-solver qualification.

method_note.ja: 連立Newtonと同じ尺度のArmijo線探索を用い、特異な初期推測は修復せず記録します。
method_note.en: Use coupled Newton with an Armijo search in the same scaled norm, retaining rather than repairing a singular initial guess.

equation_note.ja: m=L=g=1、初期角0.7、初期角速度0。非整合制御では半径方向速度を明示的に加えます。 L=m=g=1、初期角0.7、初期角速度0。C=(q·q−1)/2、T=100、h=0.04/0.02/0.01。拘束目標1e−13と粗格子の1e−10比較を固定。
equation_note.en: m=L=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity; off-manifold controls explicitly add radial velocity. L=m=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity. C=(q·q−1)/2, T=100 and h=0.04/0.02/0.01; position targets are fixed at 1e−13, with a coarse 1e−10 companion.

reference_note.ja: Jacobi解析族と独立角度ODE2計算を資格確認し、場・拘束の厳密法則・エネルギー仕事収支を比較します。 独立Jacobi解析族と角度系DOP853の資格、74主判定。有限Cの中心化恒等式、2段階FDの縮約写像診断、位置対／全状態の逆積分を分離。
reference_note.en: Qualify the Jacobi family against two independent angular ODE runs, then compare states, exact constraint laws and energy/work budgets. A separately qualified Jacobi family and angular DOP853 reference support 74 main decisions. Finite-C centered identities, two-delta reduced-map diagnostics and position-pair versus full-state reversals are distinct.

note.ja: 投影・正規化・SHAKE/RATTLEなし。一般指数3ソルバーやシンプレクティック性の検証ではありません。
note.en: No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim.

note.ja: 原著SHAKE/RATTLE本文は未読で、著者講義ノートの選択箇所を確認。有限差分のsymplectic defectは一般証明ではなく、中心化SHAKE速度にRATTLEの接線拘束を要求しません。
note.en: Original SHAKE and RATTLE full texts remain unread; selected author lecture notes were inspected. The finite-difference symplectic defect is a local proxy, not a general proof, and centered SHAKE velocity is not assigned RATTLE tangency.

method_note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
method_note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

equation_note.ja: α=1、ω=10/20、q0=(1,1/ω)、p0=0。中心probeは保存binary64のhとsin/cosをそのまま使い、πへ丸め直しません。
equation_note.en: alpha=1, omega=10/20, q0=(1,1/omega) and p0=0. Central probes retain the evaluated binary64 h and sin/cos coefficients without snapping to mathematical pi.

reference_note.ja: 116主判定。独立の結合固有モード解析、保存係数Decimal80/120・Fraction写像、段階別γ8丸め上界を区別。理想πのJordan構造は有理恒等式で別確認。 各probeは現在保存した係数hexからDecimal80/120を評価し、6精度軌道はDecimal80を用います。
reference_note.en: The 116 main decisions distinguish independent coupled normal modes, Decimal80/120 and Fraction frozen-coefficient maps, and stagewise gamma8 roundoff allowances. Ideal-pi Jordan structure is checked separately by rational identities. Each probe uses the current saved coefficient hex for its own Decimal80/120 actions; six accuracy actions use Decimal80.

note.ja: 中心の実浮動係数写像はunresolvedとし、理想πのJordan性を移しません。64刻み増幅と小さい固定入力の観測であり、走査した共鳴図・一般安定性・長時間の普遍誤差定理は主張しません。
note.en: The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.

method_note.ja: 全ポテンシャルVerletと、B半kick・A厳密flow・B半kickのStrang impulse。Aには高速調和振動子と低速自由流、Bには低速位置項と結合を含めます。
method_note.en: Full-potential Verlet and a Strang impulse composition: half B kick, exact A flow, half B kick. A contains the fast oscillator and slow free drift; B contains the slow potential and the coupling.

equation_note.ja: 無限Gaussian、有限振動2周波数、半無限Fourier、内部特異点。絶対公差1e-6/1e-8/1e-10、epsrel=0。
equation_note.en: Whole-line Gaussian, two finite frequencies, half-line Fourier and an internal singularity; absolute tolerances1e-6/1e-8/1e-10 and epsrel0.

reference_note.ja: 独立の解析区間参照と実callback数を照合します。有限Gaussianは点値でなく厳密区間です。
reference_note.en: Independent analytic interval references and actual callback counts are checked. The finite Gaussian target is an interval, not an invented erf value.

note.ja: Simpsonの特異節点失敗と未達精度を保存し、推定誤差の一般保証にしません。
note.en: Singular-node failures and unmet Simpson goals remain visible; error estimates are not general guarantees.

method_note.ja: 領域と重みを明示しfull_outputの活動prefixを保持。既存Simpson関数は不変。
method_note.en: Explicit domain/weight dispatch retains active full_output prefixes. The existing Simpson function is unchanged.

equation_note.en: Integrate exp(x), x^(-1/3) and -log(x) on[0,1], with h from1/2 to1/16 and cutoffs3/4.

reference_note.ja: 解析区間参照で全誤差、連続tail、有限窓誤差を分離します。
reference_note.en: Analytic interval references separate total error, continuous tail and finite-window defect.

note.ja: 半無限exp-sinh/全実線sinh-sinhは未実装。無限台形SUMの省略項のboundは提供しません。
note.en: Half-line exp-sinh and whole-line sinh-sinh are unimplemented; no omitted infinite-grid sum bound is provided.

method_note.ja: 共有15節点、G7次数13/K15次数23。DEは安定log式と全端点重みです。
method_note.en: Shared15-node G7 degree13/K15 degree23; DE uses stable logarithmic products and full endpoint weights.

equation_note.ja: [0,1]^d、d=2/3/4。テンソルlevel1/2/3、疎格子level1/2/3/4。
equation_note.en: The integration domain is[0,1]^d for d2/3/4; tensor levels1/2/3 and sparse levels1/2/3/4.

reference_note.ja: 解析積分と独立Delta/combination組立を区別し、L<dの相互作用未解像を可視化。
reference_note.en: Analytic integrals are distinct from companion Delta/combination assembly; interaction underresolution at L<d remains visible.

note.ja: 一般の誤差単調性、常時正重み、疎格子の費用優位は主張しません。物理PDEの空間ではありません。
note.en: No general error monotonicity, positive-weight or cost-superiority claim; these are integration coordinates, not a physical PDE space.

method_note.ja: 正規化dyadic角キーで同一節点を所有し、符号付き重みと評価台帳を保持。
method_note.en: Canonical dyadic angle keys own shared nodes; signed weights and call ledgers are retained.

equation_note.ja: 無次元区間[-1,1]、次数8・16・32、固定2048中点。節点・データ・重みは実際のbinary64値を対象にします。
equation_note.en: Dimensionless interval [-1,1], degrees 8, 16 and 32, and 2048 fixed midpoints. Actual binary64 nodes, data and weights define the discrete problem.

reference_note.ja: 格納値の補間多項式P、閉重み有理式R、格納係数級数C、目標関数fを区別。17点の正確な有理参照・演算別誤差上界・節点一致・固定Runge傾向を照合します。
reference_note.en: Separate the stored-data polynomial P, closed-weight rational expression R, stored-coefficient series C and target f. Check exact rational references at 17 probes, operation-based error bounds, node identities and fixed Runge trends.

note.ja: 標本最大誤差は連続一様ノルムの証明ではありません。丸め節点の閉重み・離散直交性は厳密と見なしません。任意次数・任意点の安定性は保証しません。
note.en: A sampled maximum error is not a proof of a continuous uniform norm. Closed weights and discrete orthogonality on rounded nodes are not treated as exact. No arbitrary-degree or all-point stability guarantee is made.

method_note.ja: 第2重心公式と全係数Clenshaw漸化式を自作。丸め済み節点上の閉形式重みと有限Chebyshev変換をそのまま保存します。
method_note.en: Implement the second barycentric formula and a full-coefficient Clenshaw recurrence. Retain the closed weights and finite Chebyshev transform on rounded nodes.

equation_note.ja: 実binary64の節点と値を使用。自然条件は両端2階微分ゼロ、clamped条件は入力端点1階微分です。
equation_note.en: Use actual binary64 knots and values. Natural conditions set both endpoint second derivatives to zero; clamped conditions prescribe the first derivatives from the input.

reference_note.ja: 正確な有理2階微分系・有理PCHIP・SciPy 1.14.1を照合。端点15記録は16スカラー出力・13異なる入力。平坦部の負値は実binary64をFraction化した独立式で示します。
reference_note.en: Compare with exact rational second-derivative systems, rational PCHIP and SciPy 1.14.1. Fifteen endpoint records contain sixteen scalar outputs from thirteen distinct inputs. Independent Fraction formulas show plateau undershoot for the actual binary64 data.

note.ja: PCHIPは通常C1でありC2とは限りません。一般データの最良近似・外挿・ノイズ平滑化は対象外。SciPyは原著完全閲読の代用ではありません。
note.en: PCHIP is generally C1, not necessarily C2. Best approximation, extrapolation and noise smoothing are outside scope. A SciPy comparison does not substitute for reading the original papers.

method_note.ja: 3次Bスプラインの配置行列を解きde Boor評価。別経路でPCHIPの調和平均・端点制限とHermite評価を実装します。
method_note.en: Solve a cubic B-spline collocation system and evaluate it with de Boor recursion. A separate path implements PCHIP harmonic slopes, endpoint limiting and Hermite evaluation.

equation_note.ja: 奇数長の各段で周期型は先頭、対称型は末尾を1点追加し、再構成時に切り戻します。詳細係数のみ閾値0.2を使用。
equation_note.en: At each odd-length level append the first sample for periodic extension or the last for symmetric extension, then crop during synthesis. Apply threshold 0.2 only to detail coefficients.

reference_note.ja: 12解析・36再構成。独立行列・Fraction/Decimal係数、完全再構成、二乗L2誤差を照合。長さ32のみ直交誤差恒等式を要求し、17点では追加エネルギーを段別保存します。
reference_note.en: Use twelve analyses and thirty-six reconstructions. Check independent matrices, Fraction/Decimal coefficients, perfect reconstruction and squared L2 errors. Require the orthogonal error identity only at length 32; retain level-by-level padding energy at length 17.

note.ja: Haarに限定し長いフィルタや画像圧縮は対象外。一般の対称拡張に正規直交性を仮定しません。シフト不変性は要求せず、シフト別差を保存します。
note.en: Limited to Haar, without longer filters or image compression. General symmetric extension is not assumed orthonormal. Shift invariance is not required; shift-dependent differences are retained.

method_note.ja: 和差フィルタ・間引き・逆ピラミッドを自作。閾値なし・hard・softの3条件を同じ解析係数から再構成します。
method_note.en: Implement pair-sum and pair-difference filters, downsampling and inverse pyramids. Reconstruct with no threshold, hard thresholding and soft thresholding from the same analysis coefficients.

equation_note.ja: 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。
equation_note.en: Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5.

reference_note.ja: 独立な全系Radau/BDF参照、縮約式の陰的スカラー恒等式、E+C=E₀とS+C+P=1、正値性、実際の採用・棄却・Newton作業を照合。初期層を含む全時間と、事前指定θ≥0.02の近似誤差を別保存します。
reference_note.en: Compare with independent full-system Radau/BDF references and an implicit scalar identity for the reduced equation. Check E+C=E₀, S+C+P=1, positivity and actual acceptance, rejection and Newton work. Retain both all-time errors including the initial layer and errors on the declared θ≥0.02 window.

note.ja: 2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
note.en: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

method_note.ja: 全4状態をSDIRK2のstep doublingで積分し、各段のNewton法では同じ重み付きL∞残差とArmijo条件を使います。縮約Michaelis–Menten式はθ上の別RK4計算で求め、全系の積分誤差と近似モデル誤差を混同しません。
method_note.en: Integrate all four states with SDIRK2 step doubling, using the same weighted L∞ residual for Newton convergence and Armijo backtracking. Evolve the reduced Michaelis–Menten equation separately with RK4 in θ, keeping integration error distinct from model-reduction error.

equation_note.ja: 無次元の捕食者・被食者系x′=x(1−y)、y′=y(x−1)、初期値(1.2,0.8)、0≤t≤20。正の象限で不変量H=x−log x+y−log yを評価します。
equation_note.en: Use the dimensionless predator–prey equations x′=x(1−y), y′=y(x−1), initial state (1.2,0.8) and 0≤t≤20. Evaluate H=x−log x+y−log y only in the positive quadrant.

reference_note.ja: 独立参照との状態誤差、Hのドリフト、保存された軌道の最小値を別々に測定。参照側では解析Jacobian、Radau/BDF差、刻み精度、Hの時間微分の恒等式を事前資格しています。
reference_note.en: Measure state error against the independent reference, drift of H and the minimum saved population separately. The reference stage qualifies analytic Jacobians, Radau/BDF agreement, tolerance refinement and the identity dH/dt=0.

note.ja: 1初期値・有限時間の固定比較です。連続系の閉軌道を引き込み極限周期とは呼びません。RK4の厳密な不変量保存、任意刻みでの正値性、長時間の構造保存は保証しません。
note.en: This is a finite-time comparison for one initial state. The continuum closed orbit is not an attracting limit cycle. RK4 is not claimed to preserve H exactly, maintain positivity at arbitrary steps or guarantee long-time geometric fidelity.

method_note.ja: 固定400/800/1600ステップの古典RK4で物理状態を積分します。独立参照はlog x・log yの変数でRadau/BDFを実行し、主計算には対数変数や保存量の射影を導入しません。
method_note.en: Integrate physical populations with classical RK4 at 400, 800 and 1600 fixed steps. Independent Radau/BDF references evolve log x and log y; the primary method uses neither a log-coordinate update nor invariant projection.

equation_note.en: Use a closed population S+E+I+R=1 with β=0.6, σ=0.3 and γ=0.2. For η=10⁻⁴ or 5×10⁻⁵, start from (1−2η,η,η,0) and evolve to t=20. There are no births, deaths or external inflows.

reference_note.ja: t≤20の全ODE積分誤差・人口保存・非負性と、0≤t≤1の201参照点での線形化モデル誤差を分けます。参照では両ηの尺度付きJacobian、Radau/BDF差とη²に対する余裕、解析的な全行列指数を別資格しています。
reference_note.en: Separate full-ODE integration error, population conservation and nonnegativity through t=20 from linearization-model error at 201 reference points on 0≤t≤1. Qualify scaled Jacobians, Radau/BDF agreement with an η² margin and the analytic full matrix exponential independently.

note.ja: 2つの小初期感染量による固定係数の整合性比較です。早期線形化をt=20全体の厳密解と見なさず、単一の優勢モードで両モードを置き換えません。実流行の予測・統計的被覆・任意人口への一般保証は行いません。
note.en: These fixed-coefficient calculations compare two small initial infection levels. The early linearization is not an exact solution through t=20, and a single dominant mode does not replace the two-mode solution. No epidemic forecast, statistical coverage or arbitrary-population guarantee is claimed.

method_note.ja: 全4状態を固定400/800/1600ステップのRK4で積分。独立非線形参照は偏差をηで尺度化してRadau/BDFで求め、早期のE・I線形化は2×2行列指数の両モードを使います。
method_note.en: Evolve all four physical states with RK4 at 400, 800 and 1600 fixed steps. Independently compute the nonlinear reference with scaled-deviation Radau/BDF and the early E/I linearization with both modes of the full 2×2 matrix exponential.

note.ja: 長時間第一原理NVE、一般の多軌道直交制約・SCF誤差、電子/核の一般熱浴、正準平衡・断熱分離・エルゴード性、実物質は未検証。
note.en: Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified.

equation_note.ja: 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。
equation_note.en: Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.

reference_note.ja: 解析勾配、4096/8192段の固定RK4感度、拡張エネルギーとOU条件付き分散を照合します。
reference_note.en: Check energy gradients, fixed4096/8192 RK4 sensitivity, extended energy, OU heat bookkeeping and conditional temperature variance.

method_note.ja: 解析BO力とCP型作用の式をVerlet/BAOABで積分し、核熱と架空電子運動エネルギーを分けます。
method_note.en: Use analytic BO forces and the declared CP-type action with Verlet/BAOAB; record nuclear heat and fictitious electronic kinetic energy separately.

note.ja: 8回の全固有対計算で824組をraw保存、規格化等の資格判定は選択24組です。節の閾値と位相は診断、HO0.003は固定例の達成目標で証明済み上界ではありません。有限壁と格子感度を相殺から独立に保証しません。
note.en: Eight full solves save824raw pairs; qualification applies to24selected pairs. Thresholded nodes/phase are diagnostics. HO0.003 is a met fixed-case goal, not a proved bound; finite-wall/mesh sensitivities do not certify separate errors.

equation_note.ja: 原子単位、ゼロDirichlet端点、一様内点格子。箱[0,1]とHO[-L,L]です。 1次元模型の原子単位でℏ=m=1、HOはω=1。箱[0,1]とHOの有限区間[-L,L]はいずれも同次Dirichlet。
equation_note.en: Finite Dirichlet boxes and central differences; whole-line HO formulas do not isolate finite-wall error. Node counts diagnostic until forward sign qualification. Atomic model units hbar=m=1 and HO omega=1. The box[0,1] and finite HO[-L,L] domains both use homogeneous Dirichlet conditions.

reference_note.ja: Decimal箱スペクトル、連続解、native規格化・直交性・残差・parityを照合します。
reference_note.en: Compare a stable Decimal box spectrum, continuum profiles, native normalization, orthogonality, residuals and reflection parity; report nodes and tail signs separately.

method_note.ja: NumPyで8回全対角化し、native824固有対を保存して低24対を表示します。
method_note.en: Use centered differences and eight full NumPy eigensolves, saving824 native pairs before selecting24 low pairs.

note.ja: 独立な演算子組立と2電子RS2恒等式で固定小模型を照合します。新しい外部PySCF参照はありません。一般分子DFT、CC、多参照法、精密エネルギー・最適化・化学精度は未実装/未検証。MP2は変分上界ではありません。
note.en: Independent operator assembly and two-electron RS2 identity qualify this fixed toy. No fresh external PySCF scalar. General molecular DFT, CC, multireference methods, precision energetics, geometry optimization and chemical accuracy remain unimplemented/unverified. MP2 is not variational.

equation_note.ja: H核3個、電荷+1、2電子、3縮約s軌道の非対称三角形1個です。 H3+の固定3中心[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr、電荷+1、2電子/3s軌道。エネルギーhartree。
equation_note.en: Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree.

reference_note.ja: 独立fermion組立、MP2行列要素の摂動式、電子数・SCF残差・FCI変分性を確認します。
reference_note.en: Check independent signed-fermion assembly, determinant perturbation MP2, electron number, SCF stationarity and FCI variational ordering.

method_note.ja: 正準RHFから2電子MP2と9x9 FCIを求め、保存軌道から密度の2D断面を描画します。
method_note.en: Canonicalize RHF, evaluate the two-electron MP2 correction and9x9 FCI, and render the saved occupied-orbital density slice.

note.ja: 自作3平面波の線形Hamiltonianです。平均占有の独立粒子Fermi模型であり、整数粒子の正準多体系ではありません。自己無撞着Hartree/XC、元素適合ノルム保存擬ポテンシャル、実金属、一般材料、長時間MDは未検証。
note.en: Authored linear3-wave Hamiltonian with independent-particle mean Fermi occupations, not an integer-particle canonical many-body ensemble. No self-consistent Hartree/XC, element-fitted norm-conserving PSP, real metal, general material or longMD validation.

Dimensionless G=-1,0,1,p=G+k,k=±.25 with equal.5weights,T=.05,mean electron countN=1.5 and spin factor2. No physical lattice-constant or metal mapping.

method_note.en: Use classicalRK4 with all stages owned by each current segment. Separately qualify removable rate singularities, a Decimal rest root and independently written DP5(4)/Cash–Karp references.

equation_note.ja: 移入率6、粒子ごとの死亡率1、時刻0/0.5/2/4。初期0・5・名目上のPoisson(6)定常標本を2seedずつ、各2,048本で比較します。

reference_note.ja: Binomial＋Poissonの厳密過渡法則を、80/120桁の有向区間・尾部上界で照合。20個のDKW目標と20個の厳密和平均目標を名目union bound0.01にまとめ、分散の5SE目標は別に残します。
reference_note.en: Qualify exact Binomial-plus-Poisson transients with directed80/120digit intervals and tail bounds. Combine20DKW and20exact-sum mean goals under nominal union bound0.01; retain five-SE variance goals separately.

note.ja: 有限時間の決定論的初期状態を定常分布とは呼びません。区間の保証は理想IID法則の参照に限り、PRNG・対数演算を含むソフトウェア全体の被覆率保証や単一軌跡の代表性を主張しません。
note.en: Finite deterministic-start transients are not stationary. Interval qualification concerns the idealIID reference law, without a whole-software PRNG/logarithm coverage guarantee or a claim that one path represents the ensemble.

method_note.ja: Gillespie direct SSAで、次の事象時刻を観測点の間で保持します。生のPCG64から開区間一様数を作り、初期Poissonの有限格子逆CDFと全ストリームを記録します。
method_note.en: Use direct GillespieSSA with pending event times preserved across observations. Draw open-grid uniforms from rawPCG64; record finite-grid Poisson initialization and all RNG streams.

equation_note.ja: D=r=1、T=1。Ablowitz–Zeppetella型の特殊波速5/√6、L=12の空間・時間系列、定数端点L=6/12/24の境界比較を固定します。
equation_note.en: Use D=r=1,T=1 and the special speed5/√6. Fix spatial/time series on L12 and constant-endpoint boundary rows at L6/12/24.

reference_note.ja: 厳密波形と1/4等値線、同一格子の時間収束、全域と中央領域の境界誤差を別保存します。実数算術の離散障壁と、実測した浮動小数点の余裕を区別します。
reference_note.en: Save exact-profile and quarter-contour errors, same-grid time convergence and full/core boundary errors. Distinguish a real-arithmetic discrete barrier from the observed floating-point margin.

note.ja: 特殊前線を一般の最小速度2の前線と同一視しません。急減衰初期値からの速度選択、長時間伝播、機械誤差込みの厳密障壁証明は対象外です。
note.en: The special front is distinct from the minimum linear speed2. This is not a steep-data speed-selection study, long-time propagation result or certified machine-error barrier proof.

method_note.ja: 2次中心差分とSSPRK3で計算し、厳密Dirichlet値を各段の時刻で与えます。時間誤差は同じ95未知数の半離散ODE参照と比較します。
method_note.en: Use centered second-order differences and SSPRK3 with exact Dirichlet values at every stage. Compare time errors to an independent reference for the same95-unknown semidiscreteODE.

equation_note.ja: [0,2π]²、T=2、a=0.1,b=0.9,Du=0.01,Dv=1。平衡(1,0.9)のまわりで3初期値と12/24/48セル、一定の非周期境界を使います。
equation_note.en: On[0,2π]² toT2,use a.1,b.9,Du.01,Dv1. Compare three perturbations of(1,.9),12/24/48cell grids and fixed nonperiodic boundary conditions.

reference_note.ja: 線形モードの連続・離散記号、角の面所有、平衡、物質収支を照合。K/Q/時間許容差感度を別に測り、参照が資格条件を満たさなければ精度・次数を未確定にします。 精度目標には、新しい細参照が同じ絶対・相対基準に合格した場合だけその参照を用います。旧参照の不合格を合格へ読み替えません。
reference_note.en: Check continuum/discrete linear symbols, corner-face ownership, equilibrium and mass ledgers. Separate K/Q/tolerance sensitivity; unqualified references leave related accuracy/order unresolved. Use the new finer reference for accuracy goals only after the same absolute/relative criteria pass; the original failed qualification is retained.

note.ja: 短時間の小振幅・固定初期値です。一般的な模様選択、成長後の成熟パターン、原著図の再現は主張しません。有限の参照差を連続体誤差の厳密上界と呼びません。
note.en: This short small-amplitude study does not establish general pattern selection, mature patterns or reproduction of original figures. Finite reference differences are not rigorous continuum error bounds.

method_note.ja: セル平均のCN拡散と局所陰的中点反応をStrang分割します。独立参照は正規直交sin/cos Galerkin、K12/18,Q96/192と2許容誤差の4列を全初期値で残します。 元のDirichlet K12/18参照は初回の相対資格基準を満たさなかったため、失敗を残し、D境界だけK24/32・Q128/192の4参照を追加します。
method_note.en: Strang-split cell-averageCN diffusion and local implicit-midpoint reactions. Independent orthonormal sine/cosine Galerkin references retain four K12/18,Q96/192,tolerance rows for every initial condition. The original Dirichlet K12/18 reference failed its first relative qualification. Preserve that failure and add four D-only K24/32,Q128/192 reference actions.

equation_note.ja: 単位正方形、T=0.25。n=1+0.1e⁻ᵗcosπx cosπy、c=1+0.05e⁻²ᵗcosπx cos2πyに合う強制項と接線方向の発散ゼロ移流を与えます。
equation_note.en: On the unit square toT.25,manufacture forcing for n=1+.1e⁻ᵗcosπx cosπy,c=1+.05e⁻²ᵗcosπx cos2πy with divergence-free tangential advection.

reference_note.ja: 36点の源項、96セル状態ベクトル、符号・欠落連成・古い段・面重複の負例を検査。空間・同一MOL時間・正値性・実際の段収支を分けて保存します。

note.en: This authored forced two-field model does not reproduce the full original biological model or demonstrate aggregation, true blow-up or suppression. No clipping is used to manufacture positivity.

method_note.ja: セル平均の中心面流束とSSPRK3を使い、n/c/強制項を同じ段に揃えます。展開した三角多項式の積分を、別の未展開積分とスカラー面ループ参照で確認します。

equation_note.ja: 質量1/2/3の1D3粒子と1つの共通調和ポテンシャル。拘束なし・COM・COM＋相対・冗長行を含む同じ拘束でf=3/2/1/1、各1,024レプリカを用います。
